gluon_pr_878.text: The MR1750 and OM5P-AC devices are based on ath9k SoCs and an external ath10k chip. All devices which are using ath10k should be marked as broken due to deficits in their IBSS support.

openwrt_pr_3720.auszug: There was already a dummy/skeleton device for OM5P-AC v2. But this could not be installed or actually used via initramfs (without the watchdog restarting the device all the time).
openwrt_pr_3720.kommentar_michaelbilcot_2021-10-12: since the move from the ar71xx to the ath79 platform, official images were broken. It was necessary to stay in 19.07.x version to be able to flash devices with ap51 or sysupgrade.

openwrt_pr_4966.auszug: OpenWrt-21.02 is already shipping (stub) images for the OM5P-AC v2 which are not working as expected.
